theorems.name: Submission.poincare_level_set_lintegral_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (u : Rn n → ℝ) (θ β c : ℝ), MeasurableSet U → AEMeasurable u (volume.restrict U) → 0 < θ → ENNReal.ofReal θ * volume U ≤ min (volume {x ∈ U | β ≤ u x}) (volume {x ∈ U | u x ≤ β}) → ∫⁻ x in U, ‖u x - β‖ₑ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 + θ⁻¹) * ∫⁻ x in U, ‖u x - c‖ₑ
